claims.claim: On a recent letter to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Senator Maria Cantwell, a leading Democrat on the Senate commerce committee, charged the Department of Commerce (DOC) with neglecting to enforce protections meant to keep Nvidia’s high‑end AI chips out of China.
